global: Pixel-art game sprite, readable at 128 pixels, clean silhouette, flat colors, no text, no border.

types.character: One human character, full body, the locked front and side are the identity.
types.npc: One town person, full body, readable face, no weapon unless the subject says so.
types.enemy: One creature, full body, the design sheet is the identity. Weapons stay on that design.
types.sub-boss: One large creature, full body, same rules as an enemy, drawn for a 2x source.
types.boss: One huge creature, full body, same rules as an enemy, drawn for a 4x source.
types.equipment: One held or worn object, centered, no person unless the skin section asks.
types.projectile: One projectile in flight, centered, plain background.
types.resource: One resource pile or node, centered, plain background.
types.ui: One interface plate or icon, centered.
types.building: One building exterior, front, no characters.
types.vfx: One effect burst, centered, plain background.

steps.still: Key pose, one facing, the subject fills the frame.
steps.four-view: Square front, left, back, and right of the same subject, matched scale, plain background.
steps.reconstruct: Use the four views. Keep the silhouette and the proportions of the lock.
steps.pose: Lift the pose from the still. Do not invent extra limbs.
steps.pixel: Integer downscale to 128, snap to the subject palette, clean alpha.
